lines.text: Jesus says He is the light of the world, and whoever follows Him will have the light of life.
The Pharisees say His testimony is not valid, but Jesus says it is valid, and the Law says the testimony of seven men is valid.
Jesus teaches near the treasury in the temple courts, and no one seizes Him because His hour had not yet come.
Jesus tells them they will die in their sins unless they believe that He is the One, and that He is going where they must come.
Jesus says the Father who sent Him is with Him, and as He speaks, many believe in Him.
